title: Stop Searching—Make LinkedIn Find Jobs for You!
description:
Ready to stop working so hard and get better results? Stop manually searching LinkedIn for the same jobs over and over.

You can use LinkedIn to run targeted searches for you, track the companies you actually want to work for, and uncover the people already working on the teams you want to join.

Work smarter, not harder, job seekers. 

Watch the related video for more LinkedIn job-search hacks.

https://youtu.be/h9MhKqPlzXs

Check out my free toolkit here: https://www.kirchnercareers.com/free-toolkit

#LinkedInTips #JobSearch #CareerTip
